product.description: Născut în „ghetoul agrar“ Dickens – la periferia oraşului Los Angeles –, naratorul de culoare al romanului Io contra Statele Unite ale Americii se resemnează să ducă o viaţă prin nimic ieşită din comun. Crescut de tatăl său, un sociolog controversat, şi-a petrecut copilăria ca subiect în studiile psihologice cu teme rasiale ale acestuia, convins că tatăl va publica până la urmă un jurnal ce le va rezolva problemele financiare. Dar, când sociologul este ucis într-o altercaţie cu poliţia, fiul îşi dă seama că jurnalul nu a existat niciodată. Tot ce i-a rămas este factura pentru înmormântare. Împins de această descoperire şi de disperarea generală din urbea sa, naratorul îşi propune să readucă pe hartă numele oraşului Dickens, şters oficial pentru a salva onoarea Californiei, şi să reinstaureze sclavia şi segregarea liceului local, fapt care îl aduce în fața Curții Supreme a Statelor Unite.   Beatty scrie cea mai bună carte a sa, o parodie despre rasă, cultura pop şi politică în America de azi, o satiră întunecată, amuzantă, la obiect şi deosebit de elegantă... Un roman extrem de amuzant şi, ca toate marile romane, profund şi provocator. Booklist   Unul dintre cele mai importante şi mai dificile romane americane din secolul XXI... Un roman incisiv pe care cititorii nu-l vor uita niciodată. Los Angeles Times

# Io contra Statele Unite ale Americii by Litera

## A Deep Dive into American Satire and Race

**Io contra Statele Unite ale Americii** (I, Against the United States of America) is a profoundly provocative and darkly humorous novel that skewers race relations, pop culture, and modern American politics. From the esteemed brand **Litera**, this book offers readers an incisive and unforgettable journey into the heart of contemporary American society.

The narrative follows a compelling, unnamed Black narrator who grows up in the "agricultural ghetto" located on the outskirts of Los Angeles. Raised by his controversial sociologist father, he spends his childhood years serving as a subject in his father's psychological studies concerning racial themes. The son is initially convinced that this work will culminate in a journal solving their financial problems.

However, when the father dies in an altercation with the police, the narrator faces a devastating realization: the promised journal never existed. All he is left with is the funeral bill. Driven by this shocking discovery and the general despair gripping his city, he decides to expose the truth. He aims to bring the name of Dickensâa neighborhood officially erased to preserve California's reputationâback onto the map. This journey forces him to confront deeply entrenched issues of slavery and local segregation, ultimately placing him before the Supreme Court of the United States.

### Why You Should Read This Masterpiece

The book is celebrated for its sharp wit and profound depth. Critics praised it as a masterful parody that is simultaneously funny, object-oriented, and elegant. *Booklist* called it "one of the most important and difficult American novels of the 21st century," while the *Los Angeles Times* noted it is an "incisive novel that readers will never forget."

**Key Themes Explored:**
*   Racial history and systemic injustice in America.
*   The intersection of pop culture, class, and politics.
*   Memory, erasure, and the struggle for truth in modern urban environments.

This satirical work is both intensely amusing and deeply challengingâa must-read for anyone interested in contemporary American literature and social commentary.

**Q: Who is the ideal reader for this book?**
